description: The NVA/VC 82-PM-41 mortar pit, crewed and animated. This is the version to include for firebases and enemy camps.
packaged_via: bpy.data.libraries.write() from the live session, 2026-08-07 — no Scene datablock, appendable/linkable component library, live .blend untouched
root_note: root sits at world X=29 in the source scene; in the packaged file it is the (0,0,0) origin of the standalone asset. All marker coordinates below are LOCAL to this root.

nva_mortar_gunner_PSXRig.role: kneels at the tube, sights and lays elevation

nva_mortar_dropper_PSXRig.role: receives rounds, drops them down the tube

nva_mortar_runner_PSXRig.role: carries rounds from the ammo pile to the dropper

cycle.note: APPROVED 2026-08-07. Do not retime, retarget, or otherwise alter this animation.

props.handoff_props: MC_round_carry (runner->dropper carry, bone-parented to LeftHand), MC_round_drop (dropper's live round, bone-parented to LeftHand), MC_round_slide (tube-slide prop)
props.ammo_pile: mortar_round_p0_0..3 (full stack) and mortar_round_p1_0..3 (depleting/staggered pile, do not replicate cycle-1 content onto these — see crew-choreography LESSONS.md 2026-08-07 entry)
props.crates: fb_ammo_crate_stack + fb_ammo_crate_stack-colonly (already carries a -colonly collider naming pattern)

work_station_convention.consumer: site_planner.gd (prefix work_ hard-coded; TYPE = everything after work_)

markers.derivation: All positions sampled from the actual armature Hips-bone world position across the 288-frame cycle (every 3rd frame), relative to NVA_MORTAR_EMPLACEMENT (identity scale/rotation). Gunner and dropper are near-static stances (hip XY range <0.02m) so a single-frame sample was used. Runner ranges from a home stance beside the ammo pile (X 2.19, Y -1.238, essentially zero-velocity across most of the cycle) to a close pass at frame 25 (0.676m hip-to-hip from the dropper) where the handoff happens; station_runner uses the home stance (matches the precedent in mortar_pit.tscn, where station_runner sits close to ammo_point), station_handoff uses the frame-25 hip midpoint. ammo_point is the centroid of the mortar_round_p0_0..3 pile. Z is ground-referenced (0.0) to match mortar_pit.tscn's own convention (its station markers all sit at Godot Y=0 / ground), not hip height.

destructible_naming_gap_FLAGGED_NOT_FIXE.summary: This pit ships INDESTRUCTIBLE and BULLETPROOF as-is if it were exported to GLB today. Flagged per recon-destructible-export skill; not restructured tonight.
destructible_naming_gap_FLAGGED_NOT_FIXE.destruction: FSB_STRUCTURE_KINDS (scripts/world/site_planner.gd:1552-1558) has no fb_mortar_pit row. To make the pit blast-destructible, the visual meshes need a recognised prefix (e.g. a new fb_mortar_pit_i row added to FSB_STRUCTURE_KINDS) — no re-export needed once that row exists, since _wire_structure_destructibles matches by mesh-name prefix already present in the GLB.
destructible_naming_gap_FLAGGED_NOT_FIXE.ballistics: Colliders must be named {base}_{i:03d}-colonly (derived from the mesh base name) for bullet_system.gd to read the right group off the exact collider hit. The one collider already in this set, fb_ammo_crate_stack-colonly, already follows that pattern; the pit's own sandbags/tube geometry currently has no separate collider authored at all in this file.
destructible_naming_gap_FLAGGED_NOT_FIXE.world_building_gap: Even with correct naming, place_structure() (site_planner.gd:162) never calls _wire_structure_destructibles today (skill section 4, 'THE GAP') -- so a mortar pit placed as a world/camp building would need that migration (M-2) before naming alone would matter. The firebase path (_wire_structure_destructibles at :1542) already calls it.
